title: MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2611.05567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite growing interest in foundation models for robotic manipulation, systematic evaluation of their capabilities remains elusive. Existing benchmarks are either narrow and saturated, offering little signal on SOTA methods, broadly scoped, providing diversity at the cost of controlled experimentation, or require training on large, messy open-source datasets. We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization. MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail. translated_title: MESA：面向机器人组合性、语义性与空间泛化的评估框架
translated_abstract: 尽管人们对机器人操作基础模型的兴趣日益增长，但对其能力的系统性评估仍然难以实现。现有基准要么狭窄且已饱和，无法为最先进方法提供有效信号；要么范围过于宽泛，以牺牲受控实验为代价换取多样性；要么需要在大型、杂乱的开源数据集上进行训练。我们提出了MESA，一个旨在对语言条件策略泛化能力进行精确、可重复测量的评估框架。MESA提供五个评估套件用于隔离分布内性能，并涵盖四个不同的泛化维度：空间配置、物体实例、物体类别和子任务组合，使研究人员能够诊断策略在何处以及为何失败，而不仅仅是判断其是否失败。为了大规模填充这些评估套件，我们开发了MESA-Gen，一个通过改进MimicGen构建的任务与演示生成流水线。我们对该框架进行了实例化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MESA评估框架，通过五个评估套件和四个泛化维度（空间配置、物体实例、物体类别、子任务组合）实现语言条件机器人策略泛化能力的精确可重复测量，并配套开发了基于改进MimicGen的任务与演示自动生成流水线MESA-Gen。
en_tdlr: MESA is an evaluation framework that precisely and reproducibly measures generalization of language-conditioned robotic policies across four axes (spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition), accompanied by MESA-Gen, an improved MimicGen-based pipeline for scalable task and demonstration generation.
